summary.text: Tom Leek, a Republican, was elected to the Florida Senate in 2024 and represents District 7; Leek served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2016 to 2024, according to the Florida Senate.

paragraphs.text: The Senate lists Leek as chief legal officer and executive vice president of Foundation Risk Partners, Corp.
Leek holds a B.A. from the University of Central Florida (1992) and a J.D. from Stetson University College of Law (1997), and was born in Columbus, Ohio, moving to Florida in 1982.

sources.title: Senator Thomas J. "Tom" Leek - Florida Senate
